_about: Anchor sources for the AirBorder report. The bibliography may hold only these keys: at most max_anchor_papers authoritative peer-reviewed conference papers, plus the project's own materials (interview/survey records, evaluation instruments, verification records) that cannot be reproduced in full in the report. Appendix-only sources are not cited. Checked by Scripts/reporting/check_citations.py. Set approved to true once the authors confirm the anchors.

anchors.paper: Fernandes, Walls, Munson, Hullman and Kay. 2018. Uncertainty Displays Using Quantile Dotplots or CDFs Improve Transit Decision-Making. CHI. doi:10.1145/3173574.3173718
anchors.supports: Probability-based leave-by recommendations and the dotplot of possible outcomes (System: probability and uncertainty; H2 deadline interpretation).

anchors.paper: Amershi et al. 2019. Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction. CHI. doi:10.1145/3290605.3300233
anchors.supports: Correction, scoped fallback, provenance labels and the safety policy that withholds recommendations without evidence (System: operational limits; model fallback).

anchors.paper: Lim, Dey and Avrahami. 2009. Why and Why Not Explanations Improve the Intelligibility of Context-Aware Intelligent Systems. CHI. doi:10.1145/1518701.1519023
anchors.supports: Explaining the changed term after a gate change and the calculation trace (Initial Design: change view; H1 and the cause-explanation metric).
